display_long_description:
Vertex VR Video Player — a powerful VR video player for Meta Quest.

  Projection: Flat (cinema-style, adjustable curvature), 180°/360° sphere, EAC (YouTube 360)
  Stereo: SBS, Top-Bottom, Mono, SBS Fisheye

  Key features:
  - Play Multiple — up to 3 videos at once (flat stacked or 180°+Flat mixed, gaze-based audio switching)
  - Network (SMB) streaming — play straight from a NAS or PC on your network; scan, pick a share; credentials stored encrypted on-device
  - Subtitles — embedded + external .srt/.vtt (local or over network), adjustable size/position, head-locked in 180°/360°
  - Spatial audio — head-tracked ambisonic (FOA/SOA/TOA) to binaural, live toggle, multichannel Opus
  - CAS sharpening with sRGB-correct color pipeline
  - 6 color profiles: Realism, Vivid, Teal & Orange, Vintage, PhotoReal, 3D
  - Adjustable sharpness, clarity, brightness, contrast, saturation, gamma, warmth, depth
  - 4K/8K decoding, smooth playback with optimized buffering
  - Internal storage, USB OTG (NTFS), and SMB network playback
  - Auto-detects video type; VR menu with drag-to-pan and thumbstick zoom
  - Synchronized multi-video controls; mirror mode, eye swap, passthrough background

  No account required. Play offline from local storage/USB, or stream from your own network shares.

  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

  🎬 JOIN OUR DISCORD — report bugs, request features, share feedback, chat with users:
  👉 https://discord.gg/fT6vcTHXkG

  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
